title: Jezero field lab — Marswalk data adapted for ARES-NAV
endorsement: NASA/USGS source data does not imply NASA approval or endorsement.

coordinateConvention.sourceProjection: Equirectangular; Mars sphere radius 3396190 m; standard parallel 18.4663°N; central meridian 0°
coordinateConvention.localDistanceApproximation: Marswalk uses radius 3389500m and cosine at 18.4447°N. Approximate tangent-plane distances; source registration uses exact supplied bounds.
coordinateConvention.verticalReference: Inherited source DEM elevation values, metres. No explicit vertical datum is supplied in this product’s retrieved PDS4 label; do not relabel as ellipsoid altitude. Scene heights are offsets from the landing DEM sample; relief exaggeration is display-only.

datasets.name: Mars 2020 Science Investigation CTX DEM Mosaic
datasets.resolutionNote: Nominal spacing in Marswalk local metric; about50.60m in original source grid. Rendering may decimate further. Interpolation adds no measured detail.
datasets.observationDateNote: Not populated in source PDS4 start/stop fields; source mosaic combines stereo observations.

datasets.name: CTX orthomosaic with Marswalk display relief tint
datasets.processing: Marswalk build_site.py: area resampling, brightness stretch, gamma0.85 and elevation-colored shaded-relief multiplication. Colors are visualization, not calibrated reflectance or natural color.

datasets.name: NASA Mars2020 HiRISE map detail, Marswalk color processing
datasets.instrument: MRO HiRISE with CTX map context
datasets.nativeResolutionNote: The supplied downloader selected z16 map tiles (approximately1.2m/pixel at18.44°N on Mars). Do not infer25cm delivery from service name.
datasets.processing: Marswalk resamples map imagery, blends HiRISE luminance detail with global relief colors. This is not an unprocessed HiRISE scientific raster.
datasets.credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Arizona; Marswalk texture processing

datasets.name: Perseverance historical traverse snapshot
datasets.classification: mission reconstruction; historical snapshot, not live
datasets.resolution: Vector snapshot; 8m simplification tolerance in supplied build_site.py; coordinates rounded to5 decimal places for traverse
datasets.coverage: Jezero mission traverse within the supplied historical snapshot
datasets.retrievalDateNote: Original download timestamp was not recorded; supplied snapshot inspected2026-11-15.
datasets.processing: Surface draping uses the delivered DEM; do not confuse display-draped height with original rover telemetry.

derivedAnalysis.slope: Calculated from the resampled DEM; finite-difference scale must be shown. Not independently observed traversability.
derivedAnalysis.routes: Computed educational routes and user targets are proposals, not actual astronaut traverses. Slope thresholds and resource rates are assumptions.
derivedAnalysis.survival: Any retained neural survival scores, shelters, habitat locations, dust/weather or suit readouts remain simulated and unvalidated.
